mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_runtime.provider_connection_credential ( tenant_id, provider_connection_id, algorithm, master_key_version, data_key_nonce, encrypted_data_key, ciphertext_nonce, ciphertext, fingerprint, rotated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{providerConnectionId}, #{algorithm}, #{masterKeyVersion}, #{dataKeyNonce}, #{encryptedDataKey}, #{ciphertextNonce}, #{ciphertext}, #{fingerprint}, #{rotatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (provider_connection_id) DO UPDATE SET algorithm = EXCLUDED.algorithm, master_key_version = EXCLUDED.master_key_version, data_key_nonce = EXCLUDED.data_key_nonce, encrypted_data_key = EXCLUDED.encrypted_data_key, ciphertext_nonce = EXCLUDED.ciphertext_nonce, ciphertext = EXCLUDED.ciphertext, fingerprint = EXCLUDED.fingerprint, rotated_at = EXCLUDED.rotated_at
mapper.select: SELECT provider_connection_id, tenant_id, algorithm, master_key_version, data_key_nonce, encrypted_data_key, ciphertext_nonce, ciphertext, fingerprint, rotated_at FROM model_runtime.provider_connection_credential WHERE provider_connection_id = #{providerConnectionId}
